name: chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot
description: Convert agentic repositories into focused ChatGPT/Codex plugins, execute available host-native Python verification, then validate, package, and prepare them for submission

interface.longDescription: Finds reusable agentic workflows inside existing repositories, decides what should become public Skills or runtime-backed capabilities, compiles portable Skill packages, designs the Plugin experience and SVG identity, prepares Plugin Directory metadata, uses host-native Python for executable verification when available, validates the package contract, produces deterministic installable ZIPs, and prepares reviewer evidence without confusing local proof with public approval.
defaultPrompt: Turn this agentic repository into a clean ChatGPT/Codex Plugin.
Find the reusable workflows in this repo and decide what should become Skills.
Audit and package this Plugin, using the python tool to run verification when available.
